questions.question_text:
A team of $6$ players is chosen from a squad of $15$ players.
In how many ways can the team be chosen if the captain must be included?

options.why: Calculated $^{15}C_{6} = 5005$, ignoring the requirement to include the captain.
Removed the captain from the available players but still chose $6$ others, calculating $^{14}C_{6} = 3003$ instead of choosing $5$.
Calculated $^{14}P_{5} = 240240$, treating the remaining team members as an ordered selection.

questions.solution_text:
Fix the captain in the team, then choose $5$ players from the $14$ remaining.
Number of teams:
$= {^{14}C_{5}}$
$= \dfrac{14 \times 13 \times 12 \times 11 \times 10}{5 \times 4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1}$
$= 2002$
